_README: INSTRUCTOR: Edit this file to set up exam study modes. Each exam becomes its own 'Exam Prep' button in the game. You do not need to touch any other file. After editing, run: npm run build

_FIELDS.id: Short unique id, letters/numbers/dashes only. Example: exam-1
_FIELDS.name: What students see. Example: Exam 1 (Chapters 2-4)
_FIELDS.date: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD. Shows a countdown to students.
_FIELDS.chapters: Array of chapter ids to pull questions from: ch2, ch3, ch4, ch6, ch7
_FIELDS.topics: Optional. Array of topic names to narrow further. Leave empty [] for all topics in those chapters. Topic names are the 'topic' field on each question.
_FIELDS.questionCount: How many questions in one timed run.
_FIELDS.minutes: Time limit for the timed run. Use 0 for untimed.
_FIELDS.passMark: Percent needed to count as a pass. Example: 80
_FIELDS.note: Optional message shown to students before they start.
